scenario.title: Mia: first dog in a small rented city apartment
scenario.room: Small apartment living room: two-seater sofa against a shared wall, TV unit with loose cables, floorboards, glass door to a narrow balcony

suggestions.name: French Bulldog
suggestions.reason: Low exercise needs and easygoing nature make them great for apartment living and new owners.
suggestions.watch_out: Plan for regular grooming and occasional check-ins during longer stretches alone at home.

suggestions.name: Coton de Tulear
suggestions.reason: Quiet, gentle, and eager to please, fitting well into a calm apartment with allergy sufferers.
suggestions.watch_out: Daily coat care is essential to keep dander low and prevent fur tangles.

suggestions.name: American Hairless Terrier
suggestions.reason: Eager to learn and non-shedding, making them ideal for a new owner with allergies.
suggestions.watch_out: Skin care and weather protection are necessary since they lack a protective coat.

suggestions.name: Chinese Crested
suggestions.reason: Quietly affectionate and very low-shedding, suited to a tranquil apartment setting and new owners.
suggestions.watch_out: Regular skin care routines are important to maintain health and keep allergies managed.

suggestions.name: Lhasa Apso
suggestions.reason: Independent and low-shedding, handling quiet apartment downtime well while keeping allergy symptoms reduced.
suggestions.watch_out: Consistent grooming is required to prevent matting and manage potential allergy triggers.

suggestions.name: Maltese
suggestions.reason: Compact, sweet-tempered, and low-shedding, making them a cozy match for a smaller apartment.
suggestions.watch_out: Frequent grooming is essential to keep their coat clean and reduce indoor allergens.

suggestions.name: Biewer Terrier
suggestions.reason: Charming and low-shedding, fitting neatly into a peaceful home setting with minimal space needed.
suggestions.watch_out: Daily brushing is needed to maintain their coat and keep household dander low.

suggestions.name: Cavalier King Charles Spaniel
suggestions.reason: Gentle, trainable, and adaptable, making them a comforting companion for a new owner.
suggestions.watch_out: Regular coat grooming helps manage light shedding for household allergy sufferers.

room_check.line: It can work. Start with this: secure the spot where a dog could get out or fall.
room_check.summary: A compact apartment living room with timber flooring, an area rug, a couch, a low coffee table, and sliding door access to a balcony.
hazards: Potted plant next to TV stand (medium)
what_to_change: Fit removable safety netting or acrylic guards along the balcony railing.
Move floor plants, including the peace lily, onto high stands or shelves.
Tidy and enclose power cables near the TV in a cord management box.
